in_sanskrit.name: Bujji
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bujji एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bujji is a Sanskrit name derived from the goddess of wealth, Lakshmi. This name symbolizes abundance, prosperity, and the blessings of the goddess. It is believed that using this name will attract wealth and good fortune.
